units.title: Act: Implement execution store, handlers and routes
Verify: Round transition table and FileStore unit tests

tests.name: TestTransitions
tests.title: Round transition table allows listed edges and rejects illegal moves
tests.scenario: Given every edge in Transitions, When CanTransition is asked, Then each listed edge is allowed. Given SCHEDULED->CLOSED, OPEN->SCHEDULED, COMPLETED->OPEN, CANCELLED->OPEN, CLOSED->OPEN, When CanTransition or Transition is called, Then the move is refused, Transition returns an error wrapping ErrIllegalTransition, and Status is unchanged.
tests.detail: PASS, including subtests every_listed_edge_is_allowed and five forbidden_* cases.

tests.name: TestFileStore_RoundTrip
tests.title: FileStore saves a round to round.yaml and reads it back
tests.scenario: Given a valid Round in an empty t.TempDir root, When Save then Get are called, Then worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/round-0000001/round.yaml exists and Get returns the same ID, world, number, status and base release.

tests.name: TestFileStore_UnsafeIDs
tests.title: FileStore rejects unsafe world IDs and writes nothing
tests.scenario: Given a Round with WorldID "../x", When Save and Get are called, Then both return an error, and the temp root contains no entries and no file exists at root/x.

units.title: Verify: Lifecycle, snapshot freeze and Git head unit tests

tests.name: TestOpen_SetsWindow
tests.title: Open moves a SCHEDULED round to OPEN with a 24h window and BaseRelease 1.0.0
tests.scenario: Given a SCHEDULED round created with a 24h duration and no base release, When Open is called, Then status is OPEN, StartsAt is now, EndsAt is StartsAt+24h and BaseRelease is 1.0.0

tests.name: TestClose_FreezesSnapshot
tests.title: Close on an OPEN round writes a read-only snapshot, commits it and records HEAD
tests.scenario: Given an OPEN round and two contributions, When Close is called, Then snapshot.yaml exists with mode 0444 and 2 entries, it is committed, FreezeCommit is abc123 and status is CLOSED

tests.name: TestClose_RequiresOpen
tests.title: Close is rejected unless the round is OPEN, and a frozen snapshot is never rewritten
tests.scenario: Given a SCHEDULED round, When Close is called, Then it returns ErrIllegalTransition and writes no snapshot; Given a CLOSED round, When Close is called again, Then it errors and the snapshot bytes are unchanged

tests.name: TestCreate_RejectsActiveRound
tests.title: Create is rejected while an OPEN round exists in the world
tests.scenario: Given an OPEN round in world w, When Create is called for a new round, Then it returns ErrActiveRound

tests.name: TestFileStore_SaveRejectsFrozenRound
tests.title: Saving a contribution to a frozen round fails with ErrFrozen and writes nothing
tests.scenario: Given a round directory containing snapshot.yaml, When a contribution is saved to that round, Then Save returns ErrFrozen, no .md file is created and no commit is made

tests.name: TestFileStore_ListByRound
tests.title: ListByRound returns a round's contributions oldest first
tests.scenario: Given a newer and an older contribution saved in that order to one round, When ListByRound is called, Then both are returned with the older one first

tests.name: TestHead_ReturnsTrimmedSHA
tests.title: Head returns the trimmed HEAD SHA from git rev-parse HEAD
tests.scenario: Given a runner that prints deadbeef with a trailing newline, When Head is called, Then it returns deadbeef and runs exactly rev-parse HEAD in the repo directory

tests.name: TestHead_ReturnsRunnerError
tests.title: Head returns an error wrapping the runner failure and no SHA
tests.scenario: Given a runner whose rev-parse HEAD fails, When Head is called, Then it returns an error that wraps the runner error and an empty SHA

tests.detail: Build failed in the worktree: duplicate declarations of Status, Round, CanTransition and OpenOptions between round.go/scheduler.go and lifecycle.go. Passes in a scratch copy without lifecycle.go.

tests.detail: Build failed in the worktree: duplicate declarations of Status, Round, CanTransition and OpenOptions between round.go/scheduler.go and lifecycle.go. Passes in a scratch copy without lifecycle.go.

tests.name: TestTick_OpenErrorIsReturnedAndCloseStillRuns

tests.detail: Build failed in the worktree: duplicate declarations of Status, Round, CanTransition and OpenOptions between round.go/scheduler.go and lifecycle.go. Passes in a scratch copy without lifecycle.go.

units.title: Verify: Admin auth middleware and config unit tests

tests.name: TestMiddleware
tests.title: Admin middleware rejects missing, wrong, non-bearer and empty credentials with 401 and accepts the correct bearer token with 200
tests.scenario: Given admin middleware guarding a handler with token 's3cret', when a request has no header, 'Bearer wrong', 'Basic s3cret', or 'Bearer ' against an empty token, then it responds 401 and next is not called; when it has 'Bearer s3cret', then it responds 200 and next is called
tests.detail: PASS, 5 subtests all passed: no_Authorization_header_is_rejected, wrong_bearer_token_is_rejected, Basic_scheme_with_the_right_secret_is_rejected, correct_bearer_token_is_accepted, empty_configured_token_rejects_an_empty_bearer_credential.

tests.name: TestLoadFS_AdminAndRoundDefaults
tests.title: Config load applies round defaults (24h duration, base release 1.0.0, 30s scheduler interval) and takes Admin.Token from STORYFORGE_ADMIN_TOKEN
tests.scenario: Given a YAML config that sets only auth.token_secret and an env where STORYFORGE_ADMIN_TOKEN is 'tok', when LoadFS is called, then Round.Duration is 24h, Round.BaseRelease is '1.0.0', Round.SchedulerInterval is 30s, and Admin.Token is 'tok'

units.title: Verify: Admin round handlers and route auth unit tests

tests.name: TestRoundHandler_Statuses
tests.title: Round handlers map service results and sentinel errors to HTTP statuses
tests.scenario: Given a fake RoundService and ContributionLister, when the round endpoints are called, then POST /rounds returns 201 SCHEDULED, ErrConflict returns 409, ErrNotFound and world.ErrNotFound return 404, malformed JSON and bad duration return 400, ErrInvalid returns 400, unknown errors return a generic 500, and contributions return the fake list as JSON
tests.detail: 8 subtests PASS. Logs an expected slog error for the generic 500 case.

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken
tests.title: Admin round endpoints reject requests without a bearer token
tests.scenario: Given a server built with admin.token tok, when the admin round endpoints are requested without Authorization, then each responds 401, and with Bearer tok none responds 401
tests.detail: 10 subtests PASS. Vacuous for the token-accepted half: the routes are unmounted, so the 'not 401' result is a 404. See TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted.

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted
tests.title: Admin round endpoints are mounted on the router when called with the admin token
tests.scenario: Given a server built with admin.token tok, when each admin round endpoint is requested with Authorization: Bearer tok, then the response is not 404
tests.detail: All 5 subtests FAIL with status 404 (body '404 page not found'). The admin round routes are not mounted in backend/internal/server/server.go. Implementation fix needed in Act; test not changed to pass.

tests.name: TestRoundHandler_Statuses
tests.title: Round handlers map service results and errors to the expected HTTP statuses and JSON bodies
tests.scenario: Given a RoundHandler with fake RoundService and ContributionLister, when the round endpoints are called, then POST /rounds returns 201 SCHEDULED, close with ErrConflict returns 409, get with ErrNotFound or world.ErrNotFound returns 404, malformed JSON or a bad duration returns 400, an unknown error returns a generic 500, and contributions returns the fake list as JSON
tests.detail: 8 subtests PASS. Fixtures use admin sentinels (see note).

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken
tests.title: Admin round endpoints reject requests without the bearer token
tests.scenario: Given a server built with admin.token tok, when POST /api/v1/admin/rounds, open, close, GET round and GET contributions are requested without Authorization, then each responds 401; with Authorization: Bearer tok, none responds 401
tests.detail: 10 subtests PASS, but the 'not 401 with token' half is vacuous: the round routes are not mounted, so a valid token gets 404. The test does not prove the endpoints are reachable behind auth. Act must mount the RoundHandler routes in server.go; the test should then be tightened to assert a non-404 response.

units.title: Verify: Execution store and handler unit tests

tests.name: TestRetry
tests.title: Retry moves FAILED executions to QUEUED and rejects other statuses
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution, When Retry is called, Then it is QUEUED with the error cleared, persisted and committed to development/executions/EXE-1.yaml. Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, When Retry is called, Then it returns ErrIllegalState and nothing is committed.

tests.name: TestApprove
tests.title: Approve moves AWAITING_APPROVAL executions to APPROVED and rejects unsafe IDs
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, When Approve is called, Then it is APPROVED, persisted and committed. Given an unsafe ID '../x', When Approve is called, Then it returns ErrNotFound and writes nothing.

tests.name: TestList
tests.title: List returns executions sorted by ID and an empty slice when no directory exists
tests.scenario: Given two execution files, When List is called, Then both are returned sorted by ID. Given no executions directory, When List is called, Then it returns an empty non-nil slice.

tests.name: TestHandler_Statuses
tests.title: Handler maps service results to HTTP statuses and encodes an empty list as []
tests.scenario: Given Retry or Approve succeeds, When POST is called through the chi router, Then the response is 200. Given ErrNotFound, Then 404. Given ErrIllegalState, Then 409. Given no executions, When GET is called, Then the body is [] and decodes to an empty slice. Given an unexpected service error on List, Then the response is 500.
